hero.title: Your books. Your taxes. One team.
hero.text: Professional bookkeeping without the paperwork headache. LeadTax keeps your books organized, your financials clear, and your business ready for tax time.

paragraphs: Why manage a separate bookkeeper and tax accountant? At LeadTax, your bookkeeping and tax professionals can work together so your records stay organized with year-end filing in mind.
That means fewer surprises, less back-and-forth, and a team that already understands your business when tax season arrives.
